sentences.text: Hon'Ble
Mr. Justice Rahul Bharti, Judge

. During the pendency of this writ petition, the petitioner No. 1-Abdul Jabbar Hajam expired on 03.04.2025 with respect to whom his legal representatives, namely, (i) Mst. Rehmta Jabar-(wife)
and (ii) Sh. Masood Jabbar Hajam-(son), came forward seeking their impleadment in his place through application CM No. 3783/2025 filed on 01.07.2025.
02.
The application is allowed and the two applicants named above are hereby impleaded as legal representatives of the deceased-petitioner No. 1-Abdul Jabbar Hajam.

sentences.text:
On behalf of the aforesaid two legal representatives of the deceased-petitioner No. 1, Mr. R.K.S.
Thakur, learned Advocate enters appearance.

04. Heard Mr. R.K.S. Thakur, learned counsel for the petitioners.
05.

The short legal point of this writ petition is whether the final land acquisition award No.
158-65/ACQ/NHAI/LA dated 27.04.2017 passed by the Collector Land Acquisition NH-1A (Additional Deputy Commissioner), Ramban is salvageable in the face of the fact that it came to be issued beyond the prescribed period envisaged under section 11(B) of the Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, Svt., 1990 by a purported reference to issuance of section 6 notification under the Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, Svt., 1990.
06.

entities.text: Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, Svt., 1990
entities.label: STATUTE

entities.text: Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, Svt., 1990
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The land acquisition process for acquisition of 195 kanals 06 marlas of land drawn from different khasra numbers of village Gund-Tethar, tehsil Banihal, district Ramban for the purpose of construction of four lane road (NA-A1) was set into effect acting upon an indent placed by the Project Director, National Highways Authority-A1 vide notification No. 1443-50/ACQ/NH-A1 dated 21.02.2011 to the Collector Land Acquisition (ADC), Ramban purportedly acting by reference to said section 4 notification.

07. As per the purported notification No. 33RD of 2011 dated 06.07.2011 issued by the Government of J&K through its Commissioner/Secretary to Government, Revenue Department, section 6 declaration was made declaring the purpose to be of public purpose for the acquisition of land and consequently, authorizing Collector Land Acquisition (ADC), Ramban under section 7 of the Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, Svt., 1990 for taking the orders for acquisition of the land.

entities.text: Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, Svt., 1990
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 08. Simultaneously, this Notification No. 33RD of 2011 dated 06.07.2011 also resorted to section 17 of the Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, Svt., 1990 envisaging taking of possession of the intended acquired land.

entities.text: Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, Svt., 1990
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
However, twist comes when said Notification No. 33RD of 2011 dated 06.07.2011 refers to acquisition of land instead in village Asher, tehsil Banihal, district Ramban and makes mockery of application of mind on the part of the Government as in one page,
Commissioner/Secretary to Government of J&K, Revenue Department, whomsoever the then was,
seems to have assigned the task of penning down the statutory notification to his/her clerical staff which is exhibited from the fact that acquisition of land is being referred for village Asher, tehsil Banihal district Ramban, but then specification is for village Tethar, tehsil Banihal, district Ramban whereas with respect to Section 17 of the Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990 which envisages authorization of taking possession, the land to be taken into possession is mentioned to be of village Ban, tehsil and district Jammu.

entities.text: Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, Svt. 1990
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
09. A mockery so sourced from Notification No. 33RD of 2011 dated 06.07.2011 passed on even to the Collector Land Acquisition (ADC), Ramban, who also did not bother to read the Notification No.
33RD of 2011 dated 06.07.2011 which authorized him to take land beyond his jurisdiction by reference to village Ban, tehsil and district Jammu.

2 10.

entities.text: Abdul Jabbar Hajam & Ors vs State Of J&K & Ors on 4 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is by intervention of this Notification No. 33RD of 2011 dated 06.07.2011 that delayed passing of land acquisition award No. 158-65/ACQ/NHA1/LA dated 27.04.2017 is being tried to be salvaged,
otherwise, the effect of section 11(B) of the Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, Svt., 1990 is to hold and declare the impugned land acquisition as nullity and thereby commanding upon the Government of UT of J&K to resort to fresh acquisition process which obviously, has to be now under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 which would raise the cost of compensation for none else than the Indenting Department-National Highway Authorities of India which cannot be faulted for the goof up that too of statutory nature at the end of the Government of State of J&K, as it was then and equally on the part of the Collector Land Acquisition (ADC), Ramban, who, by stretch of every definition, is a gazetted officer possessing at least bare minimum capability of making a literal reading of a text before him or her.

entities.text: Jammu and Kashmir Land Acquisition Act, Svt., 1990
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 11. The disposal of this writ petition is not going to take long for this Court but to be on the side of caution, this Court still would like to examine the file of the Government related to issuance of Notification No. 33RD of 2011 and accordingly, directs Ms. Nazia Fazal, learned Assisting Counsel to Mrs. Monika Kohli, learned Senior Additional Advocate General to get the record of file of issuance of Notification No. 33RD of 2011 dated 06.07.2011 issued by the Commissioner/Secretary to Government of J&K, Revenue Department.

12. Mr. R.K.S. Thakur, learned counsel arguing for the petitioners has submitted that the village Gund-Tethar, tehsil Banihal district Ramban is also falling in the line of village Asher as well as Chamalwas, tehsil Banihal district Ramban where also acquisition of land for the similar National Highway alignment were quashed by this Court with respect to judgments passed in OWP No.
477/2016 ; OWP No. 533/2016 and OWP No. 151/2016.

13. List this case in continuation on 18.12.2025.
14.
Mr. R.K.S. Thakur, learned counsel is directed to place on record the judgments passed in the aforesaid three writ petitions by the next date of hearing.

(RAHUL BHARTI) JUDGE JAMMU 04.12.2025 SUNIL Abdul Jabbar Hajam & Ors vs State Of J&K & Ors on 4 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168347070/
